low.label: On the low side
low.meaning: Less naturally relies on this dimension, and advantages often come from moderation, screening, or holding space.

mid.label: middle section
mid.meaning: This dimension will be adjusted by the context and needs to be understood in combination with tasks, objects and current load.

high.label: On the high side
high.meaning: The advantages of operating more naturally through this dimension are more obvious and the costs need to be managed.

voice_anchor: band only describes relative tendencies and does not imply superiority, diagnosis, or fixed fate.
